svg.title: Daily GET 200 requests to the main documentary population, provider-origin automated AI roles, by site
svg.desc: Three column charts, one per site, of daily GET 200 requests to the main documentary population from provider-origin automated AI roles over 30 UTC days; requests occur on 12 of these days; all days carry a partial archive report.
svg.text: Daily GET 200 requests to the main
fetches are counted for the edition only (G03): the
small-cell policy keeps them out of daily views.
Unit: requests per UTC day. Same linear scale for
Hatched strip: archive report partial (declared) for the
day. Triangle: one-request gap between aggregate and V3
counts. A flat tick is a recorded zero: no such request
in the producer table that day.
